request.query: My NexaHome loan was sanctioned on 30 June 2026. What processing fee applies to that sanction?

response.answer: Because your loan was sanctioned before 2026-07-01, the processing fee that applied at sanction remains in effect [1]: 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and maximum of ₹15,000, plus 18% GST [2].

citations.quote: Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction
Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.
All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.

request.query: What is the current processing fee for a NexaHome Loan?

response.answer: For NexaHome Loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01, the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, with a minimum of ₹5,000 and maximum of ₹10,000, plus 18% GST [1][2]. Loans sanctioned before that date retain the processing fee that applied at sanction [1].

citations.quote: 3.1 Revised clause 6.2. Processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST.

5.1 Loans covered. The revised processing fee applies only to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01. Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made.
6.1 General. All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.

request.query: What is the current processing fee for a NexaHome Loan?

response.answer: The processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus 18% GST [1]. The policy version in force on the loan’s sanction date governs that loan [2].

citations.quote: 6.2 Processing fee. Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.

request.query: Is there a foreclosure charge on a NexaFlex personal loan?

response.answer: No foreclosure is permitted before 6 EMIs have been paid. After the lock-in, the charge is 4.00% of the outstanding principal plus GST.[1]

citations.quote: 7.1 Lock-in. No prepayment or foreclosure is permitted before 6 EMIs have been paid.
7.2 Foreclosure charge. After the lock-in, foreclosure attracts a charge of 4.00% of the outstanding principal plus GST.

request.query: I was sanctioned in March 2026 and want to prepay ₹12,000. Is that allowed?

response.answer: For a loan sanctioned in March 2026 under POL-HL-V3, ₹12,000 is allowed if you opt in to the revised minimum; until you opt in, the ₹25,000 minimum applies. [1][2]

citations.quote: Borrowers whose NexaHome loans were sanctioned under POL-HL-V3 before 2026-07-01 may opt in to the revised ₹10,000 part prepayment minimum by written request to their branch or through a service request. There is no charge for opting in. Until a borrower opts in, the ₹25,000 minimum continues to apply to that loan.
8.3 Part prepayment. Part prepayment is allowed at any time. The minimum part prepayment amount is ₹25,000. No charge applies on a floating-rate loan.
